# Training/inference environment for the pinned Prithvi-UNet code.
# Versions match the reference env that produced the published results
# (Python 3.14, Linux x86_64, CUDA 13.0, torch 2.12.0+cu130).
#
# Install (setup_training_env does this for you):
#   pip install --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130 -r training-requirements.lock.txt
#   pip install --no-deps -e <pinned code checkout>
#
# Do NOT install xesmf/esmpy into this env: preprocessing prefers xESMF when it is
# importable, but the reference runs used the xarray-linear fallback, so having it
# changes the regridded predictors.
torch==2.12.0
torchvision==0.27.0
numpy==2.4.4
scipy==1.17.1
pandas==3.0.2
xarray==2026.4.0
h5py==3.16.0
h5netcdf==1.8.1
netCDF4==1.7.4
PyYAML==6.0.3
tqdm==4.67.3
packaging==26.2
filelock==3.29.0
matplotlib==3.10.9
Cartopy==0.25.0
huggingface_hub==1.14.0
requests==2.34.0
requests-cache==1.3.2
einops==0.8.2
